description: Cases every renderer of the generic kinds reproduces. For each case, decode files (text is UTF-8; base64 is raw bytes), build the model of view, and compare it with model: numbers by binary64 equality, texts exactly. snaps give the row a pointer at x reads, and locates the bin that holds a value (-1 underflow, the bin count overflow). Each refusal's view is refused with word and nothing is drawn.
